testcase.name: Scenario: Activate another expanded command while a command context menu is open: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:675:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Activate another expanded command while a command context menu is open ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full 3D Model ribbon visible ✔ And the part has no visible unadaptive sketch suitable for Bend Part ✔ And the Modify additional command area is open and unpinned ✔ When the user right-clicks Move Bodies in the additional area ✔ Then the command context menu is visible ✔ When the user clicks Bend Part outside that menu ✔ Then the context menu closes and a notice says a visible unadaptive sketch is needed ✔ And the Modify additional command area remains visible behind the notice ✔ When the user acknowledges the notice ✔ Then the notice closes and the Modify additional command area closes ✔ And no bend feature has been created
